taxonomic_tree.note: From plasmid DNA (loose rings) → nuclear DNA (trihelix in nucleus)

L0_primordial_soup.dna_type: RNA fragments — unstable, experimental, rapid mutation

L1_plasmid_rings.what: Build artifacts, compiled binaries, cargo intermediates
L1_plasmid_rings.dna_type: Plasmid DNA — circular, self-replicating, outside nucleus
L1_plasmid_rings.note: The largest non-primal mass. 560MB of compiled artifacts = the protein factory

L2_episomes.dna_type: Episomes — can integrate into genome or stay independent
L2_episomes.note: Gardens alone = 12,465 files. The experimental pool.

L3_organelle_dna.dna_type: Mitochondrial/organelle DNA — serves the cell but not in nucleus

L4_nuclear_dna.dna_type: NUCLEAR DNA — the trihelix in the nucleus
L4_nuclear_dna.note: 55% of total organism mass. THIS IS THE NUCLEUS.

L5_chromatin.dna_type: Chromatin — DNA wrapped around histones, epigenetic state
L5_chromatin.note: The memory. The knowledge. The lived experience.

trihelix_model.note: Not Watson-Crick double helix. TRIHELIX — three strands twisted together.

strand_A.name: ZK/Crypto (bearDog)
strand_A.role: IDENTITY — who we ARE, cryptographic proof of self

strand_B.name: Binary (compiled Rust)
strand_B.role: EXECUTION — what we DO, compiled and running

strand_C.name: Pi (.pi Gaia language)
strand_C.encoding: Python-like scripting, gate routes, sourdough ferments
strand_C.role: EXPRESSION — what we SAY, the living voice, the face

inner_core.name: The Asymmetrical 0/1
inner_core.what: Binary base pairing runs through the CENTER of the trihelix

pairs.G_C: Gate route ↔ Compiled handler (G=.pi route, C=.rs fn)

inner_core.note: The inner twist is ALWAYS binary. 0 or 1. True or false. Self or non-self. The asymmetry that drives everything.

geometry.double_helix_inner: Strands A (ZK) and B (Binary) form the Watson-Crick core — identity + execution
geometry.third_strand_outer: Strand C (Pi) wraps the MAJOR GROOVE of the double helix — expression sits in the groove of identity+execution
geometry.pitch: Each full turn = one wave (currently 259 turns)
